faqs.a:
Except where the hearing officer's decision under this article is advisory or an administrative
               appeal is provided by law, the decision of the hearing officer, board or commission
               shall constitute the final agency action for purposes of appeal. All final decisions
               rendered pursuant to this procedure may be appealed to the district court pursuant
               to Colorado Rules of Civil Procedure 106(a)(4). In order to determine the time limit
               for appeals, all written decisions shall contain the date of issuance.
(Code 1981, § 2-150; Ord. No. 3608, §§ 1, 2, 4-3-2003)
